excluded.name: State Forest State Park (Primitive Loop)
excluded.reason: Tent-only by the agency's own per-site wording. cpwshop's 'Primitive Loop' is not one campground but 34 sites scattered along park roads (+ the Francisco group site, group-only): a 15-site teardrop cul-de-sac 469-483 at ~40.5662,-105.9887 (1.7 km NNE of 2280's pin, 2.0 km W of 2279's; satellite shows a ~70 m dirt loop in lodgepole with one vault-toilet-like structure, no water near) with 465 beside it; pairs 421/431 (~40.574,-105.985), 440/441 (~40.581,-105.980), 415/416 (~40.540,-105.953), 402/403 (~40.545,-105.888); and 406-414, 463-464 with no GIS points. Every one of the 34 campsiteDetails pages (read 2026-10-27) says 'This site is for tent camping ONLY. Camping in a vehicle is not allowed.' -- the identical line cpwshop puts on the true tent sites (North Michigan 211, Crags 501) and absent from Bockman 302 and Mendenhall 701. The shared Know Before You Go text also grades access: 'Sites 431-439, 463-464, 469-485 are reachable with a trailer. Sites 406-408, 410-414 and 421 are reachable by a two wheel drive vehicle. Sites 415-416, 440-441 and 465 are reachable by a four wheel drive vehicle, preferably with high clearance. Sites 402-403 require a high clearance four wheel drive vehicle to reach, preferably an OHV' (402/403 add 'only accessible via OHV or 4-wheel-drive, high-clearance vehicle'), so 402-403, 415-416, 440-441 and 465 would fail on access anyway. CPW's brochure says only 'Developed sites can accommodate tents, trailers, or pick-up campers' and calls the primitive sites 'fire pit only'; The Dyrt describes the loop as a cul-de-sac of about 15 tent sites. Doubt: the trailer-reachable sites carry 'Looking For Category: RV Site,Tent Site,Trailer Site' and 30-50 ft vehicle lengths, which contradicts the tent-only line; default-down resolves to exclude. A call to the park (970-723-8366) asking whether a motorhome may camp at 469-483 could reverse it, and if so that teardrop loop (15 sites, back-ins listed 40-50 ft, median pin 40.5662,-105.9887, not waterfront) would be the one entry, not the scattered sites.
